observations: A large rounded head fills the upper two-thirds; two asymmetric eye forms glow orange-yellow against dark surrounds, the left ringed by a double oval, the right topped with a small spike crown.

A red-pink outlined mouth spans the lower face, with dense black vertical and horizontal lines crossing the tooth zone to form a grid-like interior; individual white teeth are visible but the dark opening behind them is narrow, contained by the lattice of crossing lines.
Loose red scribble lines spill beyond the figure on both sides; black-and-white striped limb shapes hang at lower left and right against a cream background.
reading: Two mismatched eyes burn orange against a dark head that fills the frame; their uneven sizes and different crown shapes make the face feel off-balance in a way that holds attention. The gridded mouth reads as both grin and cage, its teeth visible but barred behind crossing lines. Red marks escape the body's edges, while striped limbs dangle with a loose, puppet-like quality. The mood sits somewhere between comic and unsettling.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors #249 and #251. Where #249 spreads multiple figures across a wide field with bold sky-blue passages, #250 compresses a single head to the picture plane, trading open space for confrontational scale.
